scenarios.model_answer: Normalize raw EGT/N1/N2/Fuel-Flow to ISA Sea-Level Static (SLS) reference via gas-path theta/delta dimensionless ratios; confirm +28°C positive EGT margin (healthy) vs. true +14°C ΔEGT + +1.8% ΔFF HPT blade rub
